why: The behind clock run's one machine (e2e.yml with clock: behind, WORKLIST P2.4): every flow in .maestro/clock/behind, the phone's clock set behind and put back before the next, on tokens that live 180 s (e2e.yml sets them for this run alone). Read by e2e/shards.mjs and run-flows.sh; clockJudges.test.ts holds it to the folder and to clock-judges.mjs's list. Each flow signs in, opens every tab, waits 195 s, past its token, opens every tab again and logs a film: about eight minutes on the runner.
probesElsewhere: The keyboard probes and the launch with animations run in the normal rounds (e2e/shards.json); a clock run tests the phone's clock, not them.
